en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wide parade or drill ground at a military fort. In the foreground and center, large formations of mounted soldiers on horseback are assembled and maneuvering. Behind them are rows of trees and several simple wooden or brick buildings typical of a late‑19th‑century U.S. Army post. Printed red text at the top left reads "Fort Walla Walla, Wash." Handwritten dark ink notations across the upper center and right include a date and some catalog-like numbers.
